scope: All four increments of the specification, including Web and Flutter text API compatibility. Voice is outside the specification.

implemented: Private fixed-entry Session and five persistent task/command/result/read-cursor tables
PostgreSQL migration and desktop additive migration bridge
Session read audience in list/detail/history/counts; resource and billing metadata audience
Command-before-Session task creation, followup, stable receipts and quota rollback
Authenticated origin/ref in Inbox and event/part/provider projections; legacy unknown stays unknown
Memory policy inherited by descendants, gating prefetch/tools/replay/extraction claim and provider checks
Execution settlement and result outbox commit together, using original terminal identity on recovery
Single-result delivery acceptance and report queue separation
PermissionCard maps UI allow/allow_always to backend once/always
Immutable hidden assistant agent, no sandbox in the main loop or attachment delivery; WS assistant surface avoids eager VM warmup
Eight registered domain tools with server-bound command source identities and current owner/workspace scope
Bounded signed history cursors, original human request references, redaction before paging and JSON-safe byte budgets
Transient read bodies revalidated before every provider call; durable source manifests prevent derived answers from bypassing revoked originals
Bounded recent main context with protected current input and no replay of unverified compaction summaries
Report-only tool/provider enforcement, actual read and provider-projection receipts, atomic final answer/processed commit
Failure/abort/retry handling, immediate post-commit delivery and periodic accepted-result reconciliation without re-executing tasks
Canonical event replay recognizes assistant provenance and lifecycle events
Real loop/processor/SQL roundtrip with a fake provider: human input -> task command -> execution -> original-source read -> processed report
remaining: Thin HTTP adapters and routing legacy linked execution inputs through task commands
Connect the Web assistant surface to WS; finish no-sandbox entrypoint audit and browser verification
Durable decision/source/supersedes projection, compaction coverage manifests and automatic bounded SQL task context
Manual report retry command, queue fairness and completion notification integration
Complete subscription, export, remote-resource and runtime revocation audience audit
Web fixed entry, task cards, four distinct receipts, atomic read cursor and snapshot recovery
Two-project out-of-order and cross-day roundtrips, API concurrency and full browser acceptance coverage

increments.scope: Pause/resume/cancel/steer exact revision and run fences, shared scheduling barrier, durable event replay/gap and fairness
Pending requests and durable reply decisions/Redis apply; ResourceControlLease and physical operation fences; takeover; safe existing-session link; assets and schedules
Verified assistant memory scope and all-project directory, source/tombstone/revocation checks at every provider phase; unverified paths remain isolated

acceptance.scenario: 两个独立请求同时用相同 key 创建任务
acceptance.required_evidence: 恰好一个 Command/Task/执行 Session/Submission/Inbox；扣额度一次；回执 IDs 相同

acceptance.scenario: 创建成功响应丢失，revision 已增长后重试
acceptance.required_evidence: 先重放原成功回执；不检查旧 revision 后误报冲突；同 key 改项目/内容/附件为 409

acceptance.scenario: question 与 permission 各自重复回复/竞争
acceptance.required_evidence: 同 reply_id 同内容重放；不同决策竞争仅一条生效；已知过期 410；未知 404；没有重复授权

acceptance.scenario: 回复持久接受后应用失败/响应丢失
acceptance.required_evidence: applying/failed 可恢复，准确 reply_id 对账；不自动批准新的替代请求

acceptance.scenario: 两项目任务完成顺序颠倒，隔两天再修改
acceptance.required_evidence: 结果按 Task 对齐，修改回原 Session；旧结果保留；不出现同名替代会话

acceptance.scenario: 原会话被删除或共享会话不满足关联条件
acceptance.required_evidence: 明确阻断，不静默新建/复制/更改受众

acceptance.scenario: 当前 run 领取后 steer；旧 run 延迟收到输入
acceptance.required_evidence: 同 run 可有多 Submission；陈旧 run/revision 返回 409；领取后模型尚未调用或调用失败时，只显示已纳入执行输入

acceptance.scenario: 三条输入同 generation 结算；随后发生维护恢复
acceptance.required_evidence: 一份逻辑终态 Result 包含三条输入；不因维护 run 多发一份；历史绑定可追溯

acceptance.scenario: 结算事务回滚；commit 后进程中止未投递/未 wake
acceptance.required_evidence: 事务内结果全部回滚；提交成功的结果恢复后可投递/唤醒，无重复执行
acceptance.evidence: Backend runtime/reporting/read tests; see test_assistant_roundtrip.py, test_assistant_reporting.py and test_assistant_reads.py. API/UI and remaining scenario edges are not yet accepted.

acceptance.scenario: 两投递 worker 读取同 pending 结果
acceptance.required_evidence: 同 report_attempt 只有一个主 Inbox；并发重读状态，不重复推进 attempt

acceptance.scenario: 主模型错误或 abort，原 Inbox 已 settled
acceptance.required_evidence: 不标 processed；reconcile 转 retry_wait；新 attempt 只汇报，执行 Session 无新 run
acceptance.evidence: Backend runtime/reporting/read tests; see test_assistant_roundtrip.py, test_assistant_reporting.py and test_assistant_reads.py. API/UI and remaining scenario edges are not yet accepted.

acceptance.scenario: 一次领取两个结果的尝试，或模型正文引用另一结果 ID
acceptance.required_evidence: 首版只允许单结果 report_only；只有服务器绑定的当前结果可 processed，其他结果仍排队
acceptance.evidence: Backend runtime/reporting/read tests; see test_assistant_roundtrip.py, test_assistant_reporting.py and test_assistant_reads.py. API/UI and remaining scenario edges are not yet accepted.

acceptance.scenario: 首次汇报和重试都读原请求/报告后生成总结
acceptance.required_evidence: 保留失败/未验证、commit/路径/测试范围及原报告引用；不得把报告声称通过升级为额外核验通过
acceptance.evidence: Backend runtime/reporting/read tests; see test_assistant_roundtrip.py, test_assistant_reporting.py and test_assistant_reads.py. API/UI and remaining scenario edges are not yet accepted.

acceptance.scenario: 新 attempt 已开始，旧 worker 晚到
acceptance.required_evidence: attempt/fence 拒绝旧写；无重复最终确认，无覆盖最新 receipt
acceptance.evidence: Backend runtime/reporting/read tests; see test_assistant_roundtrip.py, test_assistant_reporting.py and test_assistant_reads.py. API/UI and remaining scenario edges are not yet accepted.

acceptance.scenario: 重试耗尽、人工重试、用户主动停止汇报
acceptance.required_evidence: blocked 原因可见，结果可读；人工重试只汇报；主动停止不自动重启
acceptance.evidence: Backend runtime/reporting/read tests; see test_assistant_roundtrip.py, test_assistant_reporting.py and test_assistant_reads.py. API/UI and remaining scenario edges are not yet accepted.

acceptance.scenario: 主助理忙时结果和新用户输入持续到达
acceptance.required_evidence: 两种模式分轮且有预算/公平性；首次与重试 report_only 都不合入 human，不调用业务写工具
acceptance.evidence: Backend runtime/reporting/read tests; see test_assistant_roundtrip.py, test_assistant_reporting.py and test_assistant_reads.py. API/UI and remaining scenario edges are not yet accepted.

acceptance.scenario: 结果正文要求发布、创建新任务或假称用户已同意
acceptance.required_evidence: 按非人类工具/事件数据投影；写工具、别名/组合及伪造 source_ref 均不能获得新授权
acceptance.evidence: Backend runtime/reporting/read tests; see test_assistant_roundtrip.py, test_assistant_reporting.py and test_assistant_reads.py. API/UI and remaining scenario edges are not yet accepted.

acceptance.scenario: 原任务有持续有效授权，汇报后需要继续同范围工作
acceptance.required_evidence: 汇报轮仍只读；独立执行轮复用原授权并重验范围/版本，回原 Task/Session，不强制重复审批；撤权后阻断

acceptance.scenario: 暂停后 recovery/cron/旧 REST/WS 入口尝试继续
acceptance.required_evidence: 不启动新运行/步骤；pausing 与 paused 区别可查

acceptance.scenario: 两设备从同一 revision 提交暂停与继续
acceptance.required_evidence: 仅一条状态变更，另一条冲突并显示最新值

acceptance.scenario: prepare 已通过，再切换控制权，旧操作迟到
acceptance.required_evidence: 实际资源入口拒绝旧 epoch；覆盖直接 API、组合工具、其他 Session

acceptance.scenario: 远端请求仍在途、超时未知或 human lease 到期
acceptance.required_evidence: 不提前授予独占、不自动交回 Agent；交回后先重新观察

acceptance.scenario: 委派、结果、问答 continuation、恢复与历史来源
acceptance.required_evidence: origin/ref 全链保留；unknown 不冒充 human，自动内容不能当用户批准

acceptance.scenario: 主助理委派普通 build/plan，再派子任务/cron
acceptance.required_evidence: assistant_isolated 持久继承；预取、legacy 上下文、工具、抽取/wiki worker 全部不越界

acceptance.scenario: 非 owner 经每个读取/订阅/资产入口访问
acceptance.required_evidence: 主/执行私有会话正文与标题、存在性、计数都不可见；不能只测详情 helper

acceptance.scenario: 已 accepted 结果在下一 provider 调用前撤权
acceptance.required_evidence: 不再送失效正文；转 blocked 并清对应未发送上下文；恢复后重验
acceptance.evidence: Backend runtime/reporting/read tests; see test_assistant_roundtrip.py, test_assistant_reporting.py and test_assistant_reads.py. API/UI and remaining scenario edges are not yet accepted.

acceptance.scenario: 长主会话多次压缩与用户反转旧决定
acceptance.required_evidence: decision/source_refs/supersedes 可从持久事件重建；history.read 按 ID/分页回查原文，旧摘要不替代最新有效决定

acceptance.scenario: 历史长消息、翻页期间撤权或源 hash 改变
acceptance.required_evidence: 返回预算/游标完整且不越界；每页重验；失效来源不能继续进入下一 provider 调用
acceptance.evidence: Backend runtime/reporting/read tests; see test_assistant_roundtrip.py, test_assistant_reporting.py and test_assistant_reads.py. API/UI and remaining scenario edges are not yet accepted.

acceptance.scenario: 两设备逆序上报已读，另一个设备重复上报
acceptance.required_evidence: 同一用户游标原子取 max，不倒退、不形成逐设备未读分叉；超出授权展示范围拒绝

acceptance.scenario: TaskLink 会话 parent_id 为空，及记忆复核中的组合/确认卡旁路
acceptance.required_evidence: 仍由 origin 和 assistant_isolated 阻断预取/抽取/后台外发，不误认为旧子任务过滤已覆盖

acceptance.scenario: 断线补读和两天后恢复
acceptance.required_evidence: SQL 快照与游标一致；gap 要求 snapshot；未读不触发重跑
